title: Nightwatch AI Tracking Price: What It Costs and Whether It Is Worth It
metaTitle: Nightwatch AI Tracking Price: Cost and Worth (2026)
metaDescription: Nightwatch AI tracking is included in every plan: €99/month for 50 prompts and 500 keywords on monthly billing (October 2026). Worked examples and a verdict.
shortAnswer: Nightwatch's AI tracking has no separate price: it is included in every plan. As of October 2026, Starter is €99/month on monthly billing (€79/month billed yearly) for 50 AI prompts and 500 tracked keywords; Professional is €199 for 150 prompts; Agency is €499 for 500. It is worth it if you also need keyword rankings. If you only want to know whether AI names you, it is the wrong shape.
intro:
Searches like "nightwatch tracking", "nightwatch seo tracker" and "night watch io" all lead to the same product: Nightwatch (nightwatch.io), a keyword rank tracker that added AI visibility tracking. This page gives the price first, then what the money buys and whether it is worth it. It is based on public documentation as of October 2026; we have not tested Nightwatch hands-on, so it is a pricing guide, not a hands-on review.

If you remember "$32 plus a $99 AI add-on" from older write-ups, drop it. The [pricing page](https://nightwatch.io/pricing) we checked shows no add-on.

sections.heading: How much does Nightwatch AI tracking cost?
sections.body:
AI tracking is included in every Nightwatch plan, so the price is the plan price. Starter costs €99/month on monthly billing, or €79/month billed yearly, and covers 50 AI prompts. Figures below are from [Nightwatch's pricing page](https://nightwatch.io/pricing), checked 3 October 2026.

| Plan | Monthly billing | Billed yearly | Keywords | AI prompts | AI answers / month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | €99 | €79/mo (€948 a year) | 500 | 50 | 1,500 |
| Professional | €199 | €159/mo (€1,908) | 2,500 | 150 | 4,500 |
| Agency | €499 | €399/mo (€4,788) | 7,500 | 500 | 15,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | 20,000+ | Unlimited | Unlimited |

- **Yearly is the default view.** The page leads with the yearly rate. The monthly-billing amounts are our derivation from its "Save" badges (Starter: €948 + €240 = €1,188 = 12 × €99), not text printed on the page.
- **Same tools on every plan.** All plans track ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overview. Plans differ in volume only.
- **Trial.** 14 days, no card needed to start. The page's FAQ says the account then bills monthly automatically unless you cancel.
- **Currency and promotions.** The page showed euros to our fetch. A banner advertised 30% off; we could not confirm what it covers.

sections.heading: What is Nightwatch?
sections.body:
Nightwatch is an SEO rank tracker that now also tracks AI answers. Its [homepage](https://nightwatch.io/) pitches "rank tracking and AI visibility in one platform". The rank side checks keywords daily on Google, YouTube, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps, in any location or language, with three years of SERP history, per the pricing page.

The AI side, per its [AI tracking page](https://nightwatch.io/ai-tracking), reports four numbers:

- **AI Visibility:** how often your brand appears in AI responses to your prompts.
- **Average Position:** where you land in list-style answers.
- **Share of Voice:** your presence against competitors.
- **Sentiment:** whether mentions read positive, neutral or negative.

A "prompt" here is simply a buyer question you track across AI assistants, such as "best project tool for agencies". Nightwatch also offers Citation Intelligence, which lists which URLs get cited. Both rankings and AI data sit in one dashboard; Looker Studio and white-label reports start on Professional.

![Close-up of tax documents and mixed banknotes beside a magnifying glass](https://images.pexels.com/photos/8927657/pexels-photo-8927657.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

sections.heading: What do you actually pay for? A worked example
sections.body:
You pay for volume: keywords, prompts and monthly AI answers. Two buyers with different needs show where the money goes. All figures mix euros and dollars as published, so read them as rough comparisons.

**Buyer A (hypothetical): a SaaS marketing team that tracks 300 keywords and 40 buyer prompts.** Starter fits both limits. That is €1,188 a year on monthly billing or €948 billed yearly. The AI half is effectively free. An AI-only tracker for the same 40 prompts, such as [Peec AI Starter at $95/month](https://peec.ai/pricing) (50 prompts), would be a second bill.

**Buyer B (hypothetical): a store owner who wants AI answers only, for 60 prompts.** Starter's 50 prompts are not enough, so Professional (€199) is the floor, with 2,500 keywords they may never use. AI-only options cost about the same at 60 prompts: [Otterly.AI Standard is $189](https://otterly.ai/pricing) for 100 prompts, and Peec AI Pro is $245 for 150.

The lesson: Nightwatch's price is not high for what it includes. It is high only for a buyer who ignores the half they are paying for.

sections.heading: Is Nightwatch AI tracking worth it?
sections.body:
It is worth it if you also need keyword rankings and will track a stable list of prompts for months. It is not worth it as a one-off check. Whatever you buy, read visibility percentage, not average position.

Here is why. In a study reported in January 2026, [SparkToro and Gumshoe.ai](https://sparktoro.com/blog/new-research-ais-are-highly-inconsistent-when-recommending-brands-or-products-marketers-should-take-care-when-tracking-ai-visibility/) had 600 volunteers run 12 prompts through ChatGPT, Claude and Google's AI a combined 2,961 times. There was under a 1-in-100 chance of two identical brand lists, and roughly 1-in-1,000 for the same order. The authors suggest measuring visibility percentage across dozens to hundreds of runs instead ([Search Engine Journal's summary](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/ai-recommendations-change-with-nearly-every-query-sparktoro/566242)).

Nightwatch's quota makes this concrete. Starter's 1,500 answers a month is 30 per prompt, one a day. Spread across all six platforms that is about five per prompt per platform, assuming an even split (Nightwatch does not say how it divides them). With five answers, one answer moves a percentage by 20 points. Treat week-to-week swings as noise and judge trends over months.

Start from the right baseline too. In [AEOeye's audit records](/resources/aeoeye-recommendation-benchmark-2026-09.json) (127 audits, June to September 2026, a small self-selected sample), brands were named in 157 of 892 engine answers (17.6%). Engine samples are unequal and not comparable. The point is that many brands start near zero, so [measure whether you appear at all](/blog/ai-brand-recommendation-measurement) before paying to watch it move.

sections.heading: What are cheaper ways to start?
sections.body:
Start free, confirm there is a gap, then pay for tracking only if you will act on weekly data. Five steps, cheapest first:

1. **Ask the questions yourself.** Pick five buyer questions and run each about ten times per engine in fresh chats. Count how often you are named. It costs nothing and mirrors the SparkToro lesson.
2. **Run a free audit.** [AEOeye's free audit](/) asks ChatGPT three unbranded buyer questions and shows the full answers and the competitors named. The $29 one-time report adds Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity and 10 questions. It is not a tracker.
3. **Use a free tier or trial.** [AthenaHQ's free plan](https://athenahq.ai/pricing) gives $25 of credit; [Profound's trial](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) runs 50 prompts daily for 7 days.
4. **Rent the cheapest tracker.** Otterly.AI Lite is $29/month for 15 prompts; more in our [AI visibility tracker comparison](/blog/ai-visibility-tracker).
5. **Try Nightwatch's trial** and cancel before day 14 if the dashboard does not earn its keep. See also [AEOeye vs Nightwatch](/vs/nightwatch) and [Nightwatch alternatives](/alternatives/nightwatch).

![Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone with a stopwatch running](https://images.pexels.com/photos/4114789/pexels-photo-4114789.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

keyTakeaways: Nightwatch includes AI tracking in every plan: €99, €199 and €499 a month on monthly billing for 50, 150 and 500 prompts (€79, €159, €399 billed yearly).
The old "$32 base plus $99 AI add-on" figures no longer appear on Nightwatch's pricing page.
It is good value if you also need keyword rankings; a poor fit if you only want AI answers.
Starter's quota is about 30 AI answers per prompt per month, so treat short-term swings and average position as noise.
Check whether AI names you at all with a free audit before paying to track it.

faqs.q: How much does Nightwatch cost per month?
faqs.a: As of October 2026, Starter is €99/month on monthly billing or €79/month billed yearly, Professional €199 or €159, and Agency €499 or €399. Enterprise is custom. Every plan includes AI prompt tracking. We derived the monthly-billing amounts from the pricing page's yearly totals and savings.

faqs.q: Is Nightwatch AI tracking a separate add-on?
faqs.a: Not on the pricing page we checked in October 2026. AI prompts, AI answers and all six AI platforms are included in every plan, and plans differ only in volume. Older reviews that mention a separate add-on describe packaging that the current page no longer shows.

faqs.q: Does Nightwatch have a free trial?
faqs.a: Yes: 14 days, with no credit card required to start. The pricing FAQ says the account bills monthly automatically if you do not cancel within 14 days. There is no permanent free plan.

Nightwatch is an SEO rank tracker that also tracks AI visibility. It checks keyword rankings daily on several search engines and tracks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI surfaces mention your brand for the prompts you choose. It sells both in one dashboard.

faqs.q: Is Nightwatch worth it if I only want AI visibility?
faqs.a: Usually not. You pay for rank tracking, site audit and content tools you may not use, and Starter's 50 prompts get about 30 answers each per month. If you only need a first look, a free audit costs nothing; if you need daily AI tracking, compare AI-only tools first.
